question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'The Inheritance of Loss'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kiran Desai**__.

__
 
• The **Inheritance of Loss** is the second novel by Indian author **Kiran Desai**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The Inheritance of Loss, a 2006 book by Kiran Desai, explores immigration, identity, and relationships on both the interpersonal and international scales.</span&
